prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create exactly ONE production map building sprite for tianshu default Qing north kit, early-to-mid Qing northern China. Warm-neutral historic realism with finely modeled small gray roof tiles, weathered gray brick, dark brown timber, restrained natural palette, realistic construction, softly hand-finished rendering; NOT cartoon or low-poly. Orthographic camera yaw45 elevation30; strict2:1 dimetric ground, east projects down-right slope+0.5 and north up-right slope-0.5, parallel edges never converge. Vertical posts upright. Front/south entrance faces SCREEN LOWER LEFT. Entire structure on a very thin flat rectangular contact footprint with clear left/front/right ground corners. No thick plinth. True transparent RGBA background with NO surrounding color/gray/white/black backdrop, NO atmospheric glow/halo/haze. All roof tips and base corners contained, generous15% fully transparent margin. Screen upper-left light; only tiny contact shadow to lower right, no wide drop shadow. No people, text, signs, logos, writing, modern objects, scenic background, outside trees, street scene, checkerboard or exaggerated upturned eaves. 2:1 describes projection not canvas aspect. Original game building interpretation, not a named monument. Asset bld_kit_qing_north_biaoju. Footprint15m east-west x12m north-south; preserve ground axis lengths15:12. A northern escort agency and freight courtyard: high plain gray brick enclosing walls, sturdy dark timber south gate and gate room, long one-story gray tiled rear lodging, one side warehouse shed, square earth-and-stone court, a modest timber handcart and tightly packed cloth cargo bales entirely within the court. No flags, weapons or characters. Domestic hard-gable gray tile roofs, no palace red or ornamental glazed roofing.
